script.onScreen: For the days that feel heavy. / One ayah. One lesson.

REFLECTION / The lesson / The promise comes twice, back to back: with hardship, ease. The surah then asks us to keep striving and to turn our longing to Allah. Hardship is real, and so is the ease that comes with it.
LIVE IT TODAY / Name the hardship honestly, without despair · Look for one ease that is already present · Finish today's duty, then turn to Allah in du'a
Hardship is never alone. / Save this for a difficult day

caption:
A Qur'anic reminder for the days that feel heavy.

Surah Ash-Sharh, ayat 5–6, then what comes next (7–8): keep going, and direct your longing to your Lord.

Swipe for the ayah, its context and one lesson to live today.

Save this reminder for a difficult day.
